title: Cluster 03 Drill — Cell Structure and Membrane Transport
subtitle: H2 Biology 9477 · Book 1 · 9 questions · 138 marks · cumulative over Cluster 1 + 2 + 3
los_html:
Learning outcomes, against the questions that test them.
(a) cell theoryQ1, Q2
(b) organelle and micrograph identification, microscopyQ3, Q4, Q5, Q6, Q7
(c) organelle functionsQ5, Q6
(d) the typical bacterial cellQ3, Q7
(e) virus structural componentsQ1
(f) how viruses challenge the cell theoryQ1, Q2
(j) fluid mosaic model and its constituentsQ8
(k) membrane functions, surface and internalQ8, Q12
(l) the six transport processesQ9, Q10, Q11, Q12, Q13

Two traps here have measured failure rates from a real examiner report: the centriole membrane status (Q5, only 28% correct) and which of endocytosis and exocytosis gains membrane phospholipid (Q12, 45%). Both are set so the letter is worth 1 mark and the option-by-option justification is worth 3.
